visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair wearing a black bikini with a repeating white monogram pattern dances playfully beside a curved swimming pool. She smiles broadly, moves her hips, and makes various hand gestures like thumbs-up and pointing toward the camera. The background is a bright, sun-drenched rooftop or outdoor hotel area featuring a large, white geometric glass canopy and several white lounge chairs with red patterned pillows. (2) The visual shifts to a medium close-up and headshot of the woman sitting on a white lounge chair. She continues to speak directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and frequent hand gestures to emphasize her words. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, highlighting the blue water of the pool and the clear sky visible through the canopy. Near the end, a brief still image insert shows the woman alongside another woman and a man in sunglasses standing in an outdoor green space, before cutting back to the talking head shot.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我真的好喜歡杜拜 這邊的治安是全世界最好 根本沒有人會偷東西 沒有小偷 這邊風和日麗 二三月是他們的冬季 我沒想到沙漠那麼好玩 現在沙漠完全都不會熱 我覺得還很冷 我在台灣就睡到下午 可是在這邊有4個小時時差 所以我就變成早睡早起 然後不止東西很好吃 然後也都沒有不舒服 沒有頭痛沒有烙賽 沒有水土不服 我真的是太適合這裡了 這邊的人也很歡迎外國人 對外國人非常友善 完全沒有垃圾 都市建設做得超好 然後環境很整潔 市容很漂亮 中亞非的交界處 很適合全世界的人來投資 大家如果想要來投資房地產的話 記得可以找Ted哥 我真的太愛杜拜了 我覺得杜拜唯一的缺點就是 我太窮
